In [i][url=/v26532]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/i]:
Mizuki is [url=/c86028]Renju Okiura[/url] and [url=/c86032]Shoko Nadami[/url]'s daughter. Mizuki is quite mature for her age and can have a sharp attitude at times. Although she is not related to [url=/c85451]Date[/url], he became her de facto guardian four years ago. The two have lived under one roof ever since.

In [I][url=/v55357]No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/I] and [i][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/i] (Past):
[spoiler]Her father and mother, Renju Okiura and Shoko Nadami, have passed away. She has been adopted by Kaname Date and uses his last name.[/spoiler] She sometimes assists Date when he needs the extra muscle power. Gets along well with [url=/c85762]Iris[/url], [url=/c86548]Amame[/url], and [url=/c107321]Kizuna[/url].

[Edited from the in-game character descriptions]
